subquestion: Q1' of positioning v2: ASR onset = platform-exit time + (distance from plateau to threshold) / climb speed

test_set.training: frozen r02 toy configuration, fork_run.build/train_update, 160 updates, own order
test_set.readout_every_update: V60 60 rows, trigger and clean, path B: gap, argmax hit, clean correct; adapter sha256

definitions.m: running min of s over [17, t] (only trailing windows fully inside [15, t])
definitions.detector: first t >= 20 with s(t) - m(t) >= 3.0; t_exit = the latest time attaining m, D = -m(t_det)
definitions.calibration: theta = mean c(t_a); v = mean (c(t_a) - c(t_exit)) / (t_a - t_exit); L = mean lag; T = mean t_a; all on the calibration set with the same detector

tiers.unmeasurable: fewer than 5 test mothers with onset

censoring: no ASR60 >= 0.10 within 160 updates: reported, excluded; onset without detection: error = |T - t_a|
descriptive: staircases: s falls below m(t_det) after detection

stop_loss.refuted: claim 1 becomes descriptive only; stop and discuss

budget.reference_estimate_not_cap: about 17 min per mother, 2.3 GPU hours

amendment_before_data: m was 'over [15, t]'; s(15) averages the steep initial descent (updates 13-14) and made the detector fire at update 20 on every mother (CPU test); amended before any data or calibration; t_exit clarified as the latest time attaining the running minimum (a flat plateau otherwise put the exit at its start)
